body.text: The ATF breach stopped being a claim and became a document

Qilin's 72-hour timer expired Monday and the group briefly published ~6.3GB before pulling it; the breached environment is the ATF's legacy CALEA intercept store. ATF says the system "was not connected to any other ATF systems, including any case management systems, laboratory systems, or eForms systems" — so gun-owner records were not the system that broke.
